title: How a Stray Cat Helped End a 16-Year FBI Manhunt

narration: He hid from the FBI for sixteen years.
The tip that caught him began with a stray cat.
shots.visual_description: wb6 santa monica (dawn grade); wb6_bulger: stand -> stern -> neutral (walks); wb6_greig: stand -> kneel -> relieved; camera push/pull; overlays: label '16 YEARS ON THE RUN', label 'THE CLUE: A STRAY CAT'.

sources.claim_text: Bulger was a fugitive for about 16 years: he fled shortly before his federal indictment (late 1994 per HISTORY.com; the FBI dates Greig's flight with him to 1995) and was arrested on 22 June 2011; the FBI said its task force had sought him for 16 years.

According to the Boston Globe's October 2011 reporting, repeated by CBS News, TIME and PRI, the tipster had got to know the couple when they came out to feed a stray cat, and she and Greig bonded over the animal. The FBI never publicly confirmed the tipster's identity.

narration: "Whitey" Bulger: Boston mob boss, and secretly an FBI informant.
shots.visual_description: task force (cold grade); agent_a: arms_crossed -> point_up -> stand -> stern -> hand_to_face; camera push/pull.

sources.claim_text: Bulger led a Boston organised-crime gang and had secretly been an FBI informant, protected by a corrupt FBI handler.

narration: His FBI handler warned him charges were coming.
Bulger vanished.
That agent was later convicted.
shots.visual_description: office day (cold grade); agent_a (silhouette): read -> stand_tense -> hands_behind -> bowed; camera push/pull, handheld; overlays: label '1994-95', stamp 'VANISHED', card 'THE HANDLER: / JOHN CONNOLLY / CONVICTED, 2002 / racketeering'.

overlays.text: THE HANDLER: / JOHN CONNOLLY / CONVICTED, 2002 / racketeering

sources.claim_text: His FBI handler, John Connolly, tipped Bulger off to the coming indictment, and Bulger fled. Connolly was convicted in federal court in 2002 of racketeering and obstruction of justice over his dealings with Bulger.

Bulger was a fugitive for about 16 years: he fled shortly before his federal indictment (late 1994 per HISTORY.com; the FBI dates Greig's flight with him to 1995) and was arrested on 22 June 2011; the FBI said its task force had sought him for 16 years.

narration: By 1999, he was on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list.
Fun fact: Jack Nicholson's Departed role was reportedly inspired by him.
shots.visual_description: press room (cold grade); official: stand -> point -> hands_together -> relieved; camera push/pull; overlays: funfact 'Jack Nicholson's DEPARTED mob boss / was reportedly inspired by Bulger.'.

overlays.text: Jack Nicholson's DEPARTED mob boss / was reportedly inspired by Bulger.

sources.claim_text: Bulger was on the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list from 1999 until his 2011 arrest.
Jack Nicholson's mob boss Frank Costello in The Departed (2006) is widely reported to have been inspired, loosely, by Bulger (the character's name comes from a different gangster).

narration: In 2011, the FBI tried something new.
Daytime TV ads about his girlfriend, Catherine Greig.
shots.visual_description: wb6 tv room (warm grade); wb6_viewer: sit -> focused -> sit_read -> realise; camera push/pull; overlays: label 'JUNE 2011'.

sources.claim_text: On 20 June 2011 the FBI announced a publicity campaign built around Bulger's longtime girlfriend Catherine Greig: a 30-second PSA bought on daytime TV shows with a high share of female viewers (about 350 slots in 14 markets), aimed at people such as a neighbour, hair stylist or dentist who might recognise her.

narration: Aimed at women who might recognise her.
shots.visual_description: wb6 tv room (night grade); wb6_viewer: sit_read -> realise -> hand_to_face -> worried; camera push/pull; overlays: card 'AIMED AT VIEWERS WHO / MIGHT KNOW HER: / A HAIRDRESSER. A DENTIST. / A NEIGHBOUR.'.

overlays.text: AIMED AT VIEWERS WHO / MIGHT KNOW HER: / A HAIRDRESSER. A DENTIST. / A NEIGHBOUR.

sources.claim_text: On 20 June 2011 the FBI announced a publicity campaign built around Bulger's longtime girlfriend Catherine Greig: a 30-second PSA bought on daytime TV shows with a high share of female viewers (about 350 slots in 14 markets), aimed at people such as a neighbour, hair stylist or dentist who might recognise her.

narration: The next evening, a tip came in.
From a former neighbour, in Santa Monica, California.
shots.visual_description: task force (night grade); agent_b: arms_crossed -> present -> read -> determined; keyed camera moves, handheld; overlays: label '21 JUNE 2011', label 'SANTA MONICA, CALIFORNIA'.

sources.claim_text: A tip reached the FBI on the evening of 21 June 2011, the day after the campaign was announced; the FBI called the arrest a direct result of the campaign. The tipster was a former neighbour of the couple in Santa Monica, California, where they had lived as 'Charlie and Carol Gasko'.

narration: She and Greig had bonded over a stray cat.
Fun fact: she was reportedly a former Miss Iceland.
shots.visual_description: wb6 santa monica (dawn grade); wb6_greig: kneel -> relieved; wb6_neighbour (silhouette): stand -> hands_together (walks); camera push/pull; overlays: funfact 'The tipster was reportedly / a former Miss Iceland. / She saw the news in Iceland.'.

overlays.text: The tipster was reportedly / a former Miss Iceland. / She saw the news in Iceland.

sources.claim_text: According to the Boston Globe's October 2011 reporting, repeated by CBS News, TIME and PRI, the tipster had got to know the couple when they came out to feed a stray cat, and she and Greig bonded over the animal. The FBI never publicly confirmed the tipster's identity.

The tipster was reported (Boston Globe, October 2011; repeated by CBS News, CBS Boston, TIME and PRI) to be a former Miss Iceland, who saw news coverage of the search while in Iceland and called the FBI. She reportedly received the $2 million reward. Not confirmed by the FBI; she is not named in this episode.

narration: A ruse: he was told someone broke into his storage locker.
He came down to the garage. Agents were waiting.
shots.visual_description: wb6 garage (cold grade); wb6_bulger: stand -> stand_tense (walks); agent_a: stand_tense -> present (walks); agent_b: stand_tense (walks); camera push/pull, handheld; overlays: label '22 JUNE 2011', label 'THE GARAGE'.

sources.claim_text: On 22 June 2011 FBI agents had the building manager tell Bulger that his storage locker had been broken into; he came down to the garage, where agents were waiting and arrested him (Special Agent Scott Garriola's trial testimony).

narration: Bulger, now 81, was under arrest.
shots.visual_description: wb6 garage (cold grade); agent_a: stand -> present; wb6_bulger: stand_tense -> hands_behind; camera push/pull, handheld; overlays: label 'ARRESTED · AGE 81'.

sources.claim_text: Bulger, 81, was arrested with Catherine Greig in Santa Monica on 22 June 2011.

narration: Inside: more than $800,000 in cash and 30 guns, much of it hidden in the walls.
shots.visual_description: wb6 tv room (cold grade); agent_b: stand -> torch -> realise -> torch_low; keyed camera moves; overlays: card 'NEARLY $822,000 CASH / 30 GUNS / MUCH OF IT IN THE WALLS'.

overlays.text: NEARLY $822,000 CASH / 30 GUNS / MUCH OF IT IN THE WALLS

sources.claim_text: In the apartment agents found nearly $822,000 in cash (a court filing gives $822,198, much of it in bundles hidden inside a wall) and 30 guns, most hidden in holes cut into the walls, plus false IDs.

narration: In 2013, he was convicted, including of involvement in eleven murders.
He died in prison in 2018.
shots.visual_description: courtroom (cold grade); judge: sit -> gavel -> sit; wb6_bulger [court]: hands_together -> stern -> bowed; camera push/pull; overlays: card 'AUGUST 2013 / GUILTY: 31 OF 32 COUNTS / INCLUDING INVOLVEMENT / IN 11 MURDERS', label 'DIED IN PRISON · 2018'.

overlays.text: AUGUST 2013 / GUILTY: 31 OF 32 COUNTS / INCLUDING INVOLVEMENT / IN 11 MURDERS

sources.claim_text: On 12 August 2013 a federal jury convicted Bulger on 31 of 32 counts, including racketeering, and found him involved in 11 of the 19 murders charged. He was sentenced to two life terms plus five years in November 2013.
Bulger died in federal prison in 2018 (October 2018, aged 89).

narration: Sixteen years on the run, ended by a neighbour who knew her face.
